metadata.name: Showcase Consumer
metadata.description: Minimal companion to the showcase app. Demonstrates the CONSUMER side of cross-app wiring: calling another app's cross-tenant tool via env.SPRIGR.invoke, subscribing to its cross-tenant event, and the app_installations.config override pattern.

high_value_threshold.title: High-value deal threshold
high_value_threshold.description: Deals at or above this amount are flagged when showcase.deal.won fires.

app_dependencies.reason: The consumer enriches won-deal signals by looking up the contact from the showcase app's cross-tenant tool.

tools.name: consumer_enrich_deal
tools.description: Given a won-deal signal, look up the contact from the showcase app (cross-tenant) and return an enriched record. Reads the tenant-configured high-value threshold from install config.

tools.name: consumer_on_deal_won
tools.description: Event subscription handler: reacts to the showcase app's cross-tenant showcase.deal.won event and enriches it.

tools.name: consumer_set_config
tools.description: Mirror the portal-set install config (app_installations.config) into the app's own D1 row so handlers can read it without a platform round-trip.
